WITH queries AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT screening.name_key_v1(name) AS key,type,query FROM (VALUES ($4::text,$5::text,$6::jsonb)) AS j(name,type,query))
 SELECT c.owner_scope,c.dataset_id,c.generation,c.record_id,c.entity_id,c.record,c.original,c.fuzzy_name,q.key,q.query,c.similarity
 FROM (VALUES ($1::uuid,$2::text,$3::uuid)) AS d(owner,dataset,generation)
 CROSS JOIN queries q
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT r.owner_scope,r.dataset_id,r.generation,r.record_id,r.entity_id,r.record-$8 AS record,n.original,n.fuzzy_name,public.similarity(n.fuzzy_name,q.key) AS similarity
 FROM screening.source_names n
 JOIN screening.source_records r ON(r.owner_scope,r.dataset_id,r.generation,r.record_id)=(n.owner_scope,n.dataset_id,n.generation,n.record_id)
 WHERE(n.owner_scope,n.dataset_id,n.generation)=(d.owner,d.dataset,d.generation) AND n.fuzzy_name OPERATOR(public.%) q.key AND r.entity_type=q.type
 ORDER BY public.similarity(n.fuzzy_name,q.key) DESC,r.entity_id,n.original LIMIT $7
 ) c
 ORDER BY c.similarity DESC,c.entity_id,c.original,q.key LIMIT $7

UPDATE core.screening_executions SET status=next_status,provider_reference=s.provider_reference,last_error=s.last_error,
 response_json=jsonb_build_object($34,s.id,$35,s.decision_id,$36,s.scenario_id,$37,s.screening_config_id,$38,s.status,$39,s.provider,$40,s.object_type,$41,s.object_id,$42,s.provider_reference,$43,s.last_error,$44,s.partial,$45,s.idempotency_key,$46,count_matches,$47,s.completed_at,$48,s.projection_version),
 sent_at=CASE WHEN next_status=$49 THEN $50 WHEN next_status=$51 THEN coalesce(s.sent_at,stamp) WHEN next_status=$52 THEN coalesce(e.sent_at,s.sent_at,stamp) ELSE coalesce(e.sent_at,s.sent_at) END,
 completed_at=CASE WHEN next_status=$53 THEN coalesce(s.completed_at,stamp) ELSE $54 END,
 failed_at=CASE WHEN next_status=$55 THEN coalesce(s.failed_at,stamp) ELSE $56 END,
 updated_at=now(),projection_source_id=s.id,projection_version=s.projection_version
 WHERE id=e.id AND tenant_id=tenant

SELECT r.owner_scope,r.dataset_id,r.generation,r.record_id,r.entity_id,r.record-$3,n.original
 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS d(owner uuid,dataset text,generation uuid)
 JOIN screening.source_names n ON (n.owner_scope,n.dataset_id,n.generation)=(d.owner,d.dataset,d.generation)
 JOIN screening.source_records r ON (r.owner_scope,r.dataset_id,r.generation,r.record_id)=(n.owner_scope,n.dataset_id,n.generation,n.record_id)
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT $4 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS q(name text,type text) WHERE q.name=n.normalized AND q.type=r.entity_type)

WITH candidate AS (
 SELECT id FROM screening.case_event_outbox
 WHERE (status='pending' AND available_at<=now()) OR (status='delivering' AND lease_until<=now())
 ORDER BY available_at,created_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
 UPDATE screening.case_event_outbox o SET status='delivering',attempts=attempts+1,lease_until=now()+interval '60 seconds'
 FROM candidate c WHERE o.id=c.id RETURNING o.id,o.kind,o.payload,o.attempts

SELECT d.owner_scope,d.id,d.label,d.category,CASE WHEN v.status=$4 AND v.normalizer=$3 AND (c.connector IS NULL OR $2 OR c.ready) THEN d.active_generation END,v.published_at,coalesce(v.record_count,$5),coalesce(g.revision,$6),coalesce(c.connector,$7),coalesce(c.rights_state,$8),coalesce(c.enabled,$9),c.last_success_at,coalesce(c.ready,$10),coalesce(v.normalizer,$11)
 FROM screening.source_datasets d LEFT JOIN screening.source_versions v ON (v.owner_scope,v.dataset_id,v.id)=(d.owner_scope,d.id,d.active_generation)
 LEFT JOIN screening.source_readiness_v1 c ON (c.owner_scope,c.dataset_id)=(d.owner_scope,d.id)
 LEFT JOIN screening.source_grants g ON g.tenant_id=$1 AND (g.owner_scope,g.dataset_id)=(d.owner_scope,d.id)
 WHERE d.enabled AND (c.connector IS NULL OR $2 OR c.rights_state=$12) AND (($2 AND d.owner_scope=$13) OR (NOT $2 AND g.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND (d.owner_scope=$14 OR d.owner_scope=$1)))
 ORDER BY d.owner_scope,d.id LIMIT $15

INSERT INTO case_manager.case_screenings(id,tenant_id,case_id,screening_id,match_id,status,partial,created_at)
 SELECT gen_random_uuid(),s.tenant_id,$3,s.id,m.id,m.status,s.partial,$4
 FROM screening.screenings s JOIN screening.screening_matches m ON m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.screening_id=s.id
 WHERE s.tenant_id=$1 AND s.id=$2
 ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,case_id,screening_id,match_id) WHERE match_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status,partial=EXCLUDED.partial
